name: Container Development Tools Bundle
description: Complete container development suite: Docker/Podman runtimes + analysis/security tools (dive, trivy, hadolint, buildah, skopeo, ctop) - ideal for teaching container workflows

postInstallCheck.command: sh -c 'command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker --version || command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1 && podman --version || echo "container runtime not found"'
postInstallCheck.description: Verify representative container runtime (docker or podman) is available
